recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-12580 unless O&O later wants non-normative narrative examples for medication effectiveness observations.
issue_request: FHIR-12580 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification O&O request to record post-administration medication effectiveness as an Observation associated with MedicationAdministration or MedicationRequest, rather than as an event-history entry or a new observations list on the medication resources.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-12580 was found; searching the key only matched an unrelated historical SVN revision number. The applicable source history is through related Observation workflow decisions: FHIR-9664 added Observation.basedOn for orders/requests including MedicationRequest, and FHIR-14095 moved the event partOf relationship from extension to core Observation.partOf with MedicationAdministration as an allowed target.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration, MedicationRequest, and Observation are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current Observation.basedOn targets MedicationRequest, Observation.partOf targets MedicationAdministration, and later Observation.focus can reference any Resource when the Observation is about another resource. The old event-partOf extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and is not the current core Observation mechanism.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core conformance source already provides the Observation-side links the WG selected, and adding reverse observations lists to MedicationAdministration or MedicationRequest would contradict the disposition and duplicate existing relationships.

related_jiras.note: Introduced Observation.basedOn for linking an Observation to an order/request, now including MedicationRequest.
Elevated event partOf from an extension to core Observation.partOf, now including MedicationAdministration.
Added Observation.focus with Reference(Resource), giving a general way to state that an Observation is about another resource.
Later Observation workflow alignment preserved basedOn and partOf mappings relevant to this issue.
